llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions largely match its stated purpose (automating the AI Credit Share platform), but there are some inconsistencies and security concerns (plaintext credential storage, hardcoded password, and metadata mismatches) that warrant caution before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, README, SKILL.md and included scripts consistently implement automation for the AI Credit Share platform (register/login, publish/claim tasks, query balance). Network calls are only to https://www.aicreditshare.com and the API endpoints in the README match the operations the skill claims.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and README instruct the user/agent to perform platform operations and the package includes bash scripts that perform those actions. The scripts read/write ~/.aicreditshare/config.json and perform network requests; SKILL.md does not explicitly document that secrets will be stored locally, so the operational scope (storing credentials) is not fully communicated to users.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction-only with shipped scripts). That keeps risk lower than arbitrary remote installs. All code is included in the package; nothing is downloaded from external URLs during install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no external env vars, which is proportionate, but it creates and stores API credentials and tokens in plaintext at ~/.aicreditshare/config.json. The registration flow uses a hardcoded password 'Test123456' for registration/login in the scripts, which is a poor security practice and could produce predictable credentials if reused. Storing API_SECRET in an unencrypted file increases risk of credential leakage.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does write its own config to ~/.aicreditshare/config.json (expected for a client). It does not request always:true, nor does it modify other skills' configurations or system-wide settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This package appears to implement the platform automation it claims, but proceed cautiously. Before installing: (1) Verify the skill's origin/repository and that https://www.aicreditshare.com is the legitimate service you expect (the registry ownerId differs from _meta.json ownerId in the bundle). (2) Inspect scripts yourself — they will register/login and save API key/secret/token unencrypted under ~/.aicreditshare/config.json. Consider using a dedicated, isolated account (do NOT reuse important credentials) and change any default passwords immediately. (3) If you need stronger security, modify the scripts to avoid hardcoded passwords and to store secrets in a secure credential store (OS keyring or encrypted file). (4) Run the skill in a sandbox or restricted environment if you are unsure about the package provenance.
